answer: A sybil farm shares one hidden operator, so its clones fault together. Make every key stake onyx, a scarce non-mintable collateral, behind an ex-ante independence claim committed at entry that names its distinct inputs. A farm must forge that claim, since its heads truly share a root. When keys fault in the SAME epoch, their jointly bonded onyx is burned together, not merely frozen, opening a canyon in the pooled stake that deepens with each added clone. Honest keys fault idiosyncratically and keep their bond; the correlated failure exposes the forged claim and slashes the lie, not raw chance.
